picks.reasoning: T1's players are better than LOS's in every role, and nobody hyping an underdog changes that. In a best of 1 the better players still win, so I'm taking T1.

T1 play quick and clean early: Oner pathing to set up first herald and grubs, lanes getting priority, and they've taken the map by 15 minutes before LOS can even react. In a Bo1 the side that wins the early tempo snowballs it, and that side is T1.

T1's champion pools run deeper across every role, and Faker gives them comfort picks the opponent can't ban out of a single draft. LOS needs a draft-phase surprise to have a chance, and a Bo1 gives them one shot at it, not enough to flip this.
T1's international record and their win rate against wildcard-tier opponents at Worlds put them far ahead of LOS. A best of 1 leaves some room for an upset, so I'm keeping this short of a lock.

T1 walk into Worlds like family. This core trusts each other and stays calm under pressure, and that matters most in a single game. LOS will come in hungry and with nothing to lose, but they haven't yet built that kind of steadiness on this stage.
